notes: Only the card itself survives (headed "CARD SUBJECT TO CHANGE"); no results text exists anywhere in the corpus read so far, so every entrant here is recorded as billed, not as having wrestled. The card's own preview text confirms Ultra Brawl IX's own missing Unification Main Event ended in a draw between Hawkeye and Nero, that Main Frame and Blackout were subsequently merged into one roster, and that the World Heavyweight Championship sat vacant pending this 16-man tournament -- all already reflected in reigns.json (euwc-world-r018/r019, euwc-championship-r002). The tournament's own actual winner (STEALTH, beating Daymon in the final) and the North American/International title defenses' own outcomes are already independently confirmed by the titles' own dedicated ledgers, predating this pass's own crawl, and are not asserted here as billed-only facts. Diabolic Forces are described as "Four Time World Tag Team Champions" fighting "for the first time in over a year... without the Tag Team titles" -- confirming an off-page title loss reigns.json's own euwc-worldtagteam-r068 doesn't yet reflect; flagged there rather than closed on a guessed date.
